data.entity_name: PT Rafita Product and Price Catalog
data.content:
PT Rafita Product and Price Catalog
The PT Rafita Product and Price Catalog lists the current inventory used to design the bundling strategies.

WFH Pro Kit
The WFH Pro Kit is a product bundle designed for remote workers, including a mechanical keyboard, office desk mat, and fast charger.

Rafita Mechanical Keyboard (RAF-KBD-MECH)
The Rafita Mechanical Keyboard (RAF-KBD-MECH) is a product included in the WFH Pro Kit with limited stock of 85 units.

Rafita Office Desk Mat (RAF-MAT-01)
The Rafita Office Desk Mat (RAF-MAT-01) is a product included in the WFH Pro Kit.

Rafita Fast Charger 65W (RAF-CHG-65)
The Rafita Fast Charger 65W (RAF-CHG-65) is a product included in the WFH Pro Kit.

Urban Commuter
The Urban Commuter is a product bundle targeted at students and daily commuters, combining a backpack and tumbler.

Rafita Backpack Neo (RAF-BPK-NEO)
The Rafita Backpack Neo (RAF-BPK-NEO) is a product included in the Urban Commuter bundle with ample stock over 200 units.

Rafita Tumbler Swiss Edition (RAF-TMB-SW)
The Rafita Tumbler Swiss Edition (RAF-TMB-SW) is a product included in the Urban Commuter bundle with ample stock over 200 units.

Audio-Active Set
The Audio-Active Set is a product bundle pairing a smartwatch and wireless earbuds for fitness enthusiasts.

Rafita Smartwatch V1 (RAF-SMW-01)
The Rafita Smartwatch V1 (RAF-SMW-01) is a product included in the Audio-Active Set.

Rafita Wireless Earbuds (RAF-TWS-01)
The Rafita Wireless Earbuds (RAF-TWS-01) is a product included in the Audio-Active Set.

Rafita Smart Home Hub (RAF-HUB-01)
The Rafita Smart Home Hub (RAF-HUB-01) is a product with exactly 60 units held, positioned as an ultra-premium item for VIP campaign.

Rafita Closer
Rafita Closer is the loyalty program whose top 100 members are targeted for the exclusive VIP campaign.

Google Ads (Search)
Google Ads (Search) is the primary marketing channel allocated for the WFH Pro Kit.

TikTok & Instagram Ads
TikTok & Instagram Ads are the primary marketing channels allocated for the Urban Commuter bundle.

Makassar logistics hub
The Makassar logistics hub is the new facility used to prioritize order fulfillment for Eastern Indonesia.

Eastern Indonesia
Eastern Indonesia is the region whose order fulfillment is prioritized through the Makassar logistics hub.

Professionals, Tech Enthusiasts
Professionals and Tech Enthusiasts are the target demographic for the WFH Pro Kit marketed via Google Ads.

Students, Millennials
Students and Millennials are the target demographic for the Urban Commuter marketed via TikTok & Instagram Ads.

Remote workers
Remote workers are the target audience for the WFH Pro Kit bundle.

Students and daily commuters
Students and daily commuters are the target audience for the Urban Commuter bundle.

Fitness enthusiasts
Fitness enthusiasts are the target audience for the Audio-Active Set bundle.

Email Marketing
Email Marketing is the channel used for the exclusive VIP campaign targeting Rafita Closer members.

Top 100 members
Top 100 members are the highest-tier members of the Rafita Closer loyalty program targeted for early access.

Average order value
Average order value is a metric the bundling strategies aim to increase.

Inventory
Inventory refers to the current stock levels listed in the PT Rafita Product and Price Catalog.
